extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: PURPOSE

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: The purpose of this policy is to ensure access to high-quality care for Devoted Health

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: members through the provision of telehealth services. It establishes the framework for

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: reimbursement of telehealth services, including telephone services, virtual check-ins, and

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: e-visits. Telehealth services are defined as healthcare delivered remotely via

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: telecommunications technologies, and occur when the healthcare provider and the patient

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: are in separate locations, employing technology to bridge healthcare delivery.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: APPLICABILITY

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health Plans.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: POLICY

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Outlined below are the telehealth services covered under this policy, including, but not

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: limited to, specific codes, place of service (POS) designations, and common modifiers. For the

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: purposes of this policy, telehealth encompasses synchronous and asynchronous

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: communication between providers and our members. This includes live, interactive audio or

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: audio-visual sessions, and asynchronous exchanges.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Providers must ensure that claims clearly indicate when services are delivered via telehealth.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Whether identified through place of service (POS) codes, telehealth modifiers, or other

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: documentation, we will process claims as long as telehealth delivery is evident.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Additionally, providers must meet all CMS requirements for rendering telehealth services,

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: including licensure, scope of practice, and professional standards in the state(s) of both the

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: practitioner and patient.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Note on Telehealth Waivers

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Devoted Health has been applying Congressionally-authorized telehealth coverage waivers,

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: which are set to expire on September 30, 2025. Effective October 1, 2025, claims for telehealth

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: services will be subject to applicable CMS limitations unless the services qualify under an

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: additional telehealth services benefit. For further details on these limitations, refer to CMS

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: guidance provided in the References section of this policy.

extracted_content.content: DEVOTED HEALTH FOR PUBLIC USE

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Additional Telehealth Services

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Telehealth services covered under an additional telehealth benefit in the member's

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: applicable Evidence of Coverage (EOC) are eligible for reimbursement. Unless restricted by

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: federal statute or regulation, Devoted Health will allow additional telehealth services if the

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: following conditions are met:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● The service is clinically appropriate for delivery via telecommunications-based

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: technology.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● The service is covered under the plan's benefit structure.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● All applicable coding and billing requirements are satisfied.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Other Virtual Services

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Devoted Health also covers other virtual services that are reimbursable under Original

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Medicare but are not classified as telehealth services, including:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● E-visits

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Virtual check-ins

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ● Remote monitoring

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Below is a detailed breakdown to clarify the scope of reimbursement and compliance

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: requirements.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Telehealth Services

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Coverage includes original Medicare telehealth services, as well as other virtual services, such

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: as telephone services, e-visits, and virtual check-ins. Telehealth services must meet CMS

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: guidelines, including applicable CPT/HCPCS codes and modifiers. Services may include

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: synchronous audio-visual sessions, asynchronous exchanges, and audio-only services where

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: applicable.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Additional Covered Services

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: In addition to the Medicare-covered and additional telehealth services, the following services

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: are covered under this policy. These services may be provided via telehealth and are intended

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: to support the care and management of patients with various healthcare needs. The list

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: below includes, but is not limited to, the following services:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Annual Wellness Visits HCPCS codes G0438 and G0439.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Behavioral health integration and advanced care planning.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Chronic Care Management (CCM) and Transitional Care Management (TCM) Services:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: CPT codes 99495 and 99496.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ End-stage renal disease (ESRD) and nutrition therapy services.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Psychiatric Services CPT 90791, 90792, and psychiatric codes 90832-90838.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Remote Physiologic Monitoring: CPT codes 99453-99458.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Remote Therapeutic Monitoring: CPT 98975 and CPT 98980

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Modifiers

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: The following modifiers should be used when submitting claims for telehealth services to

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: indicate the type of telehealth service provided and the mode of communication used.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Properly using these modifiers ensures accurate billing and compliance with payer

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: requirements for telehealth services.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Modifier 93: Audio-only telehealth services (not required for 98000 - 98015 series).2

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Modifier 95: Audio-visual telehealth services (not required for 98000 - 98015 series).3

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: DEVOTED HEALTH FOR PUBLIC USE

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Page 4 of 10

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Modifier FQ: For RHCs and FQHCs only. Report modifier for mental health visits using

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: audio-only technology.4

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Modifier G0: Telehealth service provided for purposes of diagnosis, evaluation, or

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: treatment of symptoms of an acute stroke

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Modifier GQ: Telehealth service rendered via an asynchronous telecommunications

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: system.3

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Modifier GT: For distant site practitioners billing telehealth under the CAH Optional

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Payment Method II. Institutional claims must be submitted using the GT modifier.3

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: CPT Code Updates

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Please note, the following updates to the CPT code set will apply to telehealth claims. These

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: changes reflect the removal of outdated codes and the addition of new codes that will be

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: accepted for telehealth services. Please review the details below to ensure proper billing and

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: avoid delays in payment:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Removals: Codes 99441-99443 will be retired, and no longer accepted on claims.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Claims submitted with these codes will be denied for payment or subject to delays.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: ○ Additions: The 98000 - 98016 code series were introduced in CY24 to represent

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: different forms of telehealth. Devoted Health will be accepting them on claims.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: Key Notes

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Audio-Video Visits

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Include codes 98000 to 98007.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Cover both new and established patients with varying levels of

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: decision-making complexity and time spent.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Use these codes for synchronous telehealth visits where video interaction

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: occurs.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Audio-Only Visits

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Include codes 98008 to 98015.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Address scenarios where the interaction is via phone or other audio-only

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: technology.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Applicable for new and established patients, with time thresholds aligning with

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: the complexity of decision-making.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Virtual Check-ins:

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Code 98016 is specific to brief communication technology-based services.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ Typically involves 5 to 10 minutes of medical discussion with an established

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: patient.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: How to submit claims

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: When submitting claims for telehealth services, providers must adhere to the following billing

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: guidelines to ensure compliance with telehealth policy and avoid delays in processing:

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: 1. Professional Claims:

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Use the CMS-1500 claim form or electronic equivalent (837P).

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: DEVOTED HEALTH FOR PUBLIC USE

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: Page 6 of 10

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Include appropriate POS code to designate telehealth service location.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ POS Code 02: Telehealth provided outside the patient's home. Intended only

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: for professional claims. Should not be billed on institutional claims.1

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ○ POS Code 10: Telehealth provided in the patient's home. Intended only for

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: professional claims. Should not be billed on institutional claims.1

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Append the relevant telehealth modifier to the CPT/HCPCS code based on the service

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: type (audio-only, audio-visual, etc.). These are not required for the 98000-98015 series

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: as type included in description:

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Modifier 93: For audio-only telehealth services.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Modifier 95: For audio-visual telehealth services.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: 2. Institutional Claims:

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Use the UB-04 claim form or electronic equivalent (837i).

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Confirm the service location and documentation meet CMS requirements for

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: reimbursement of telehealth facility fees.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● The Q3014 code (telehealth originating site facility fee) should only be billed on

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: institutional claims, as it is not applicable to professional claims.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: 3. Modifiers

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Use the correct modifier to accurately reflect the type of telehealth service provided.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: Modifiers help distinguish the delivery method (e.g., audio-only, audio-visual) and the

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: service type.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● The list of relevant modifiers is provided in the Modifiers section above. Ensure the

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: correct modifier is appended to claims based on the type of telehealth service

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: rendered.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: 4. Documentation

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ● Providers must ensure that all necessary documentation is submitted with claims,

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: including evidence that the service was delivered via telehealth. This includes

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: documentation of the telehealth service, whether it was synchronous or

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: asynchronous, and the use of the appropriate technology (audio-only, video, etc.).

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: Providers are encouraged to regularly review CMS guidance and telehealth services lists to

extracted_content.title: Key Notes
extracted_content.content: ensure compliance with all billing requirements.

extracted_content.title: Key Notes

extracted_content.content: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: E-visits: Non face-to-face, patient-initiated communication through secure patient portals.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: Applicable to both new and established patients.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: Telehealth Services: Medical services provided remotely via telecommunications technology,

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: encompassing both synchronous (real-time) and asynchronous communications.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: Telephone Services: Evaluation and management (E&M) furnished via telephone or online by

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: a physician or qualified healthcare professional. Applicable for established patients only.

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: Virtual Check-ins: Brief (5-10 minutes) communication with a patient via telephone, video, or

extracted_content.title: ACRONYMS AND DEFINITIONS
extracted_content.content: image exchange. Applicable for both new and established patients.
